item.title: Neural Expansion: A Unified Mechanism for Deep Network Generalization
item.description: Proposed Generalization Intervals framework explaining why more than 90% of correct predictions occur within directional stability regions defined by Jacobian singular values. This work provides a unified mechanism to understand how deep networks generalize to unseen data.

item.title: Enhancing Visual Spatial Reasoning through Multi-Task Learning
item.description:
• Developed SpatialViLT, a vision-language model integrating depth maps, 3D coordinates, and edge representations to improve spatial grounding and cross-modal alignment in embodied intelligence systems.
  • Leveraged multi-task learning to enhance 3D scene understanding for downstream robotic navigation and manipulation, improving Visual Spatial Reasoning (VSR) benchmark performance by 2.1%.

item.title: Robust Vision Transformers (ViTs) - Understanding and Mitigating Representation Vulnerabilities
item.description: Examined vulnerabilities in Vision Transformers (ViTs), revealing how small input changes affect layer-wise representations. Proposed NeuroShield-ViT to neutralize vulnerable neurons and enhance adversarial robustness. Improved classification accuracy by 54.85% against PGD attacks and 71.6% against IGO attacks on ImageNet1K.

item.title: The Illusion of Precision: Numerical Instability of Large Language Models
item.description: Discovered microscopic input perturbations cause 10-million-fold amplification in LLMs, collapsing logit margins and triggering unpredictable token flips. This study highlights fundamental reliability gaps in current large language models.

item.title: Adversarial Exploitation in Robot Vision-Language Navigation
item.description:
• Developed a vision-language navigation (VLN) framework for embodied robotic agents, analyzing perception-to-action pipelines within vision-language-action (VLA) architectures.
  • Studied how representation shifts propagate through navigation policy networks, affecting task planning and real-world embodied decision making.
  • Achieved 91.7% landmark-conditioned path redirection and proposed a robustness-aware detection mechanism improving navigation policy stability by 96.3%.

item.title: Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Large Language Models
item.description:
• Developed an adversarial attack for LLMs using regularized gradients with continuous optimization to generate valid tokens.
  • Improved attack success rate by ~60% and reduced the time taken by 3 orders of magnitude, significantly enhancing efficiency.

item.title: Multimodal Classification with LLMs - Unstructured Text Feature Extraction
item.description:
• Created text processing pipelines with private LLMs for feature extraction through in-context learning.
  • Built fusion models combining unstructured and tabular data, boosting multimodal classification accuracy from 76% to 83%.

item.title: Inherent Vulnerabilities of Vision Transformers for Medical Image Classification
item.description:
• Explored vulnerabilities in vision transformers, showing that minor changes significantly alter representations.
  • Developed an efficient detection method achieving 73.1% accuracy, enhancing model reliability for medical image classification.

item.title: Leveraging Superresolution for Enhanced Analysis of Low-Resolution Content
item.description:
• Evaluated SOTA models for identifying low-resolution deep fakes in collected video data.
  • Improved deep fake detection, boosting test accuracy by 19% on the FaceShifter dataset with Xception Net.

item.title: Retrieval of Brain Tumor with Region Based Image Segmentation
item.description:
• Engineered an automated brain tumor segmentation pipeline with Anisotropic Filtering for denoising and skull removal.
  • Achieved an 11.58% precision increase and 9.1% accuracy improvement over the SOTA adaptive filtering method.
